adb.analysis: Static signature visible (syscall 0x65, 0x9d, rdtsc). If patched cleanly to return 0, silent entanglement evaluates to identity (XOR 0). However, if an emulator or tracer causes DbgToken!=0 without crashing immediately, silent entanglement systematically corrupts downstream register arithmetic.

bcf.analysis: BCF employs hardware-dependent dynamic opaque predicates (CPUID feature bit checks & RDTSC parity) chained with polymorphic memory barriers. Pure static SMT solvers cannot evaluate hardware register state at compile-time without concrete architecture assumptions.
